<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Please use the latest GPT Image 2.5 image generation capability of the web version to directly generate images, and do not just return the prompt.

Generate a complete visual design drawing of the Chinese official website of a creative design company, a long screenshot of the desktop webpage with a frontal view and no perspective, 9:16 vertical format, with as high a resolution as possible, and a complete display from navigation to footer. White background, cobalt blue, bright yellow, coral red and light sky blue colors, narrow white space, neat grid, right-angled cards, bold bevel geometric collage. The overall look is young, lively, and has a sense of design experimentation.

There is a slim white navigation bar at the top, with the original bold Chinese character mark "见造" and the small slogan "以创意，让世界更有趣" on the left. The navigation on the right is "关于我们、创意服务、精选作品、加入我们、最新动态", and the blue "联系我们 →" button is on the far right.

The first screen occupies about 27% of the entire image. On the left side, there are two lines of "让有趣，" and "改变世界。" in very eye-catching bold cobalt-blue sans-serif type. On the lower left side are small characters "以自由的想象，连接人与品牌，让每一个好点子，成为真实的改变。". On the right side is a clearly adult 20 year old Chinese woman. Black shoulder-length hair is blown by the breeze. She has natural light makeup and real skin. She slightly raises her head and looks to the upper right. Wear a cobalt blue cotton and linen stand-up collared short-sleeved top with a simple slanted placket and a few buttons of the same color. It fits well but is not tight. The character is combined with a blue cube, yellow sphere, coral red ring, and white geometric pedestal. The background is light blue sky and bright natural daylight. The materials and cast shadows are credible.

The white concept horizontal bar at the bottom of the first screen accounts for about 8%, with the small characters "我们的理念" on the left, the bold black title "用创意，为社会留出想象。" in the middle, and the text "我们相信，好的设计不止解决问题，也让人与世界产生新的连接。" and "了解见造 →" on the right.

The service area occupies about 16%, with a narrow column title "创意服务", a brief introduction and "查看全部服务 →" on the left; three equal-width cards on the right: a blue background card with a hand-held light bulb photography as "品牌创意", a yellow background card with colorful geometric building blocks as "传播设计", and a coral red background card with an open laptop as "数字体验". Below each card are two lines of brief Chinese introduction and a right arrow.

The works area occupies about 17%, with the titles "精选作品" and "查看全部作品 →" on the left, and four columns of thumbnails of the flat works on the right, which are a 20-year-old Chinese female portrait poster decorated with colorful paints, an urban geometric installation poster, a blue, white and red editorial design, and a mountain art installation poster. The names of the four projects are "自在生长", "城市游乐场", "灵感发生地" and "山野之间" in order, and the visible text in the thumbnails are all in Chinese.

The recruitment area occupies about 18%, with the entire cobalt blue horizontal bar, the white title "和有趣的人，一起创造新风景。" on the left, the text "让热爱成为日常，让灵感自由生长。" and the white button "查看开放职位 →". On the right, three clearly adult Chinese women aged 20 sit on the yellow and coral red geometric steps and communicate naturally. They are wearing blue stand-up collar tops, off-white cotton and linen shirts, and light yellow simple knitted tops, loose trousers and clean flat shoes. They have long black hair or short shoulder-length hair, natural light makeup, youthfulness, confidence, and kindness. They are not ancient costumes, not professional suits, and have no exaggerated accessories.

About 6% below is the "最新动态" column with a white background, and the three lines of messages are "2026.09.09 见造全新品牌网站正式上线", "2026.09.08 城市游乐场创意计划发布" and "2026.09.01 秋季创意伙伴招募开启". The last approximately 8% is a concise footer, with Chinese "见造", navigation and "© 2026 见造创意。保留所有权利。", leaving a comfortable bottom margin. All interface copy is in readable and accurate Simplified Chinese, with clear levels of title and text. No Japanese, no garbled characters, no third-party logos, no watermarks, no browser borders, no device cases. Output a complete web design drawing.
```

[English](README.md#user-content-case-fixed-template-product-swap) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-fixed-template-product-swap) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-fixed-template-product-swap) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-fixed-template-product-swap) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-fixed-template-product-swap) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-fixed-template-product-swap) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-fixed-template-product-swap) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-fixed-template-product-swap) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-fixed-template-product-swap)

<a href="https://x.com/AdrianPunk115/status/2098055380857143807"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HR2hSJmbAAAE0l0?format=jpg&amp;name=large" width="640" alt="Product replacement in a fixed poster — @AdrianPunk115 — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Replace a poster’s main product while preserving its layout, typography, and background.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- Image 1: the existing advertising poster.
- Image 2: the new product reference.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Please edit Image 1 by replacing the main product with the product shown in Image 2.

Strictly separate the functions of the two reference images:
Image 1 dictates the advertising composition, background, lighting direction, decorative elements, and text layout (excluding the product itself).
Image 2 dictates the new product's authentic shape, structure, material, color, logo, and packaging details.

Remove the old product from Image 1 and naturally place the product from Image 2 into the area previously occupied by the original product.

Preserve the authentic aspect ratio of the product from Image 2; do not squash, stretch, or alter its structure to fit the original outline. You may scale the product proportionally as a whole to fit the original layout.

Modify only the area occupied by the new product, along with any necessary contact shadows, occlusions, and local reflections resulting from the replacement. Do not recreate the entire poster.

Keep the headline, text content, font, font size, positioning, background texture, decorative elements, and canvas dimensions unchanged.

Do not create a hybrid design combining the two products. Do not retain the old product's cap, handle, label, or other components.

Do not add accessories not present in Image 2, do not guess at illegible packaging text, and do not alter the product's color to match the background.

Output only the single, completed poster with the product replaced.
```

<a href="https://x.com/jackzhang123vip/status/2098414576031481953"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HR8McVcasAAxJwu?format=jpg&amp;name=large" width="640" alt="Three-reference product advertisement — @jackzhang123vip — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Separate product identity, lighting, and layout references with an explicit priority order.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- Image 1: the product reference with its original label.
- Image 2: the desired color and light reference.
- Image 3: a layout reference showing product placement and empty space.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Image 1 is the primary reference for the product itself; Image 2 provides only the color, lighting, tonal values, and overall atmosphere; Image 3 provides only the composition, product placement, visual proportions, and negative space structure. Conflict priority: Product authenticity and label accuracy from Image 1 > Layout structure from Image 3 > Color and lighting from Image 2. Create a 1024×1536 vertical commercial product advertisement. Use the exact shampoo bottle from Image 1, placing it fully on the left side of the frame, while reserving a large, clean, and uniform area of ​​negative space for copy on the right, as shown in Image 3. Apply the atmosphere from Image 2—featuring soft warm light entering from the top-left, low-saturation creamy tones, pale apricot hues, and grey-green accents—but do not replicate the objects found in Image 2. Fully preserve the product's shape, proportions, amber glass, ivory-white pump structure, label size and placement, leaf graphic, and the two lines of accurate text ("“山野洗发露”" and "“净含量 300毫升”"). The text must be clear, in the correct order, and appear only on the product label. Do not redesign, recolor, distort, crop, duplicate, or alter the product. Only physically accurate reflections and natural contact shadows may be added to integrate the product into the environment. The product must be fully visible with safe margins around it; no text may be generated on the right side. Do not replicate the spheres, glass cubes, fabric, cylinders, products, text, logos, or branding elements from Image 2 or Image 3.
Do not add copy, placeholder text, English text, garbled characters, QR codes, watermarks, extra packaging, props, people, or a second product.
```

<a href="https://x.com/AdrianPunk115/status/2098055380857143807"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HR3Ai-DbwAAWrPT?format=jpg&amp;name=large" width="640" alt="Transparent product studio relighting — @AdrianPunk115 — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Move a transparent product into a dark studio and reconstruct transmission, reflections, and contact shadows.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- A transparent or translucent product reference with visible shape, label, and contents.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Please place the transparent or semi-transparent product I uploaded into a new commercial photography scene.

Retain the original product's outline, proportions, thickness, bottle neck or opening structure, label placement, and legible packaging text. If the product contains liquid, retain its color and level.

The new scene uses a dark gray studio background, with the product placed on a low-reflectivity, dark surface. A soft, large-area light source is positioned on one side, with a restrained warm-toned rim light behind.

Focus on the optical relationship between the product and the new environment: Transparent areas should show the new background without retaining the original photo's background color or objects; Present visually reasonable changes in light transmission and refraction based on the product's shape; Surface reflections should match the new light source; Retain natural contact shadows at the bottom.

Allow changes in reflection, lighting, and the background seen through the product, but do not alter the product's structure, color, label, or contents.

Do not turn transparent glass into opaque plastic, frosted materials into completely transparent materials, or add chrome effects to areas that were not originally present.

Retain the original product's shooting angle; do not show the unreferenced back. Generate only one 3:4 vertical product photo, without adding props or text.
```

[English](README.md#user-content-case-bouncing-cutout-sticker) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-bouncing-cutout-sticker) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-bouncing-cutout-sticker) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-bouncing-cutout-sticker) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-bouncing-cutout-sticker) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-bouncing-cutout-sticker) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-bouncing-cutout-sticker) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-bouncing-cutout-sticker) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-bouncing-cutout-sticker)

<a href="https://x.com/AdrianPunk115/status/2098055380857143807"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/tweet_video_thumb/HR2diHLbUAAtO5A.jpg" width="640" alt="Bouncing cutout sticker GIF — @AdrianPunk115 — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Turn a subject into one transparent sticker, then animate that same cutout with Python.

**Original prompt · Multi-step workflow · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- A reference image containing the subject.
- A chat environment that can generate images and run Python to export a GIF.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>

#### Step 1

```text
Please convert the uploaded image into a standalone sticker suitable for creating an animated sticker.

Automatically identify the main subject of the image:
For people, preserve recognizable facial features, hairstyles, clothing, and expressions;
For animals, preserve breed characteristics, fur color, patterns, and expressions;
For objects, preserve unique outlines, structures, and primary color schemes;
If the image is primarily a scene, design the entire scene as a sticker with a clean outline.

Adopt a slightly 3D cartoon sticker style with clear outlines, full forms, and a touch of humor. Do not replace different subjects with a uniform face, and do not force limbs onto objects that do not naturally have them.

Include a clean white die-cut border around the sticker. Center the subject and leave sufficient space around it; do not crop the subject.

Generate only a single sticker; do not create a grid, add text, or show the sticker applied to other objects.

Use a 1:1 square canvas and output a PNG with a true alpha transparency background; do not render the transparency checkerboard pattern into the image itself.
```

#### Step 2

```text
Please read the previous sticker image and use Python to create a functional, looping GIF from it.

First, check if the image has a true transparent background; if there is an opaque background, separate the subject from the background so the background does not move along with the subject.

On a fixed solid white canvas, animate the subject performing a light, bouncy movement:
Pause briefly, wind up slightly by moving downward, spring upward, squash slightly upon landing, and then return to the original shape.

Use only the original sticker asset; create the animation by adjusting position, slight rotation, and minor scaling. Do not redraw the character frame-by-frame, and do not alter facial features, patterns, colors, or clothing.

Ensure the movement range is moderate and transitions are smooth; keep the subject fully within the canvas at all times and ensure a natural loop transition. Keep the background static—no flickering or trailing artifacts.

Output a 512×512 pixel, approximately 2-second, infinitely looping GIF file. Verify that the file contains multiple frames before providing the final product; do not simply return code or a static preview. If the current environment cannot execute the code or export the file, please explicitly state so.
```

[View this case on Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com/prompt/community-bouncing-cutout-sticker?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=case--en--bouncing-cutout-sticker)

</details>

### Make it your own

Follow the steps in order. Reuse prior outputs where required and check external processing before starting.

### Notes

- This is a distinct illustrated recipe within the creator’s GPT Image 2.5 tutorial. The article’s shared engagement is not assigned to individual recipes.
- The preview is a result shown by the author; required references must be supplied by the reader. The repository has not independently tested this workflow.
- Image generation and Python file processing are separate steps. GIF export requires a tool that can execute code; it is not an image-only output.
- Approve the transparent cutout first, then adjust bounce height and duration in Python. Keep its canvas and pivot fixed so the exported GIF does not jitter.

<a href="https://x.com/HoodyLiu/status/2099115784417251690"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HSGOUDQbYAAFxpB.jpg" width="640" alt="Color-grade a garden photo while preserving its composition — HoodyLiu — source result — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Control sky highlights, shadow detail and foliage color while preserving the photographed scene.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- Upload the second source image below, or your own garden photograph.

Source reference images: [1](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HSGOiw-a8AAd-1r.jpg)

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Please only perform professional color grading and light and shadow optimization on the original photos, strictly retain the original composition, scenery positions, cherry blossoms, trees, water reflections and screen proportions, and do not add, delete or change any objects. The overall style is adjusted to a high-end, restrained, and quiet Japanese film style, presenting the quiet atmosphere of a Japanese garden in early spring. Moderately brighten the dark details in the woods, waterfronts and ponds, and restore the layers of tree trunks, shrubs and water surfaces, but retain deep shadows and do not turn black areas into gray. Reduce the sky highlights and blue saturation, and adjust the sky to a transparent, calm gray-blue to avoid excessive brightness and HDR effects. Highlight the cherry blossoms in the center of the picture, making the flowers a natural pale pink-white color to add soft sunlight transparency and delicate layers. Do not turn it into pure white or fluorescent pink. The green plants are adjusted to low-saturated moss green, forest green and slight olive green, reducing the yellow-green and digital feel. The water surface maintains a deep blue-black color, enhancing the subtle reflections and layers of fallen cherry blossoms, making the reflection clear but not sharp. The overall design uses soft highlights, deep shadows, medium to strong contrast, and slightly increases the contrast between warm sunlight and cool shadows. Adding slight film fog, natural halo, fine 35mm film grain and soft sharpening, the color refers to Kodak Portra 400 and Japanese film photography, which is real, natural, subtle, airy and high-end. It is prohibited to change the composition, add cherry blossoms, clouds, buildings, people or lights, generate new branches, change the season, overexposure, dead black, HDR, over-sharpening, fluorescent green, brilliant blue sky, heavy filters, oil painting feeling, illustration feeling and AI redrawing feeling. The end result must be like a professional color correction of the original RAW photo, not a regenerated image.
```

<a href="https://x.com/AdrianPunk115/status/2098055380857143807"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HR3Bg2JbsAAXdH6?format=jpg&amp;name=medium" width="640" alt="Coherent multi-product studio lineup — @AdrianPunk115 — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Please combine the multiple product photos I uploaded into a single main image with a unified shooting style.

The main product in each reference image should be treated as an independent and unambiguous object. Each product should appear only once in the final image, without omissions, repetitions, or merging.

Accurately preserve the unique shape, structure, color, material, logo, label, and legible text of each product. Do not mix bottle caps, color schemes, packaging patterns, or labels from different products.

Place all products on the same studio table to create a simple, layered display. Slight spatial relationships between products are acceptable, but the main display surface and brand information should be clearly visible.

Use the angles already shown in the reference images for each product whenever possible; avoid actively showing the back side where no reference is available.

Use consistent light source direction, color temperature, sharpness, and touch shadows to make them appear as if they were taken in the same shot, avoiding a patchwork effect with different backgrounds and lighting.

Use a simple, neutral background that coordinates with the overall color scheme of the product set and does not overshadow the main products. Do not change the product colors to match the background.

Do not add any unprovided products, gifts, gift boxes, packaging bags, prices, or promotional text.

Generate a 1:1 square main image of the combined product set, ensuring all products are fully visible within the frame.
```

[English](README.md#user-content-case-nine-emotion-chat-stickers) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-nine-emotion-chat-stickers) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-nine-emotion-chat-stickers) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-nine-emotion-chat-stickers) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-nine-emotion-chat-stickers) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-nine-emotion-chat-stickers) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-nine-emotion-chat-stickers) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-nine-emotion-chat-stickers) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-nine-emotion-chat-stickers)

<a href="https://x.com/AdrianPunk115/status/2098055380857143807"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HR25mF4a0AA43OY?format=jpg&amp;name=medium" width="640" alt="Nine expressive chat stickers — @AdrianPunk115 — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Create a consistent 3×3 sheet of nine distinct reactions from one character reference.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- A person, animal, or illustrated character reference image.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Please transform the main person, animal, or cartoon character from the uploaded image into a custom set of chat stickers.

First, extract the subject's most distinctive features, then convert them into a unified, simple, vivid, and slightly exaggerated hand-drawn sticker style. Preserve facial feature proportions, hairstyle or fur, distinctive patterns, clothing, and the primary color scheme; do not transform the subject into a generic, nondescript character.

Generate a neatly arranged 3×3 grid image. The character in all nine cells must be the same, maintaining consistency in appearance and art style.

Depict the following expressions and poses, proceeding from left to right and top to bottom:
Laughing heartily, looking completely puzzled, speechless/dumbfounded;
Suddenly shocked, aggrieved/on the verge of tears, secretly smug/pleased;
Exhausted/sleepy, pouting/angry, expressing affection.

Each cell must feature a distinct expression and pose that remains recognizable even when scaled down. Actions should suit the subject's physical anatomy; do not force a realistic human body onto an animal.

Leave white space around each sticker; do not let them touch each other. Do not draw dividing lines or add text. Use a pure white background and a 1:1 square aspect ratio.
```

</details>

## Person holding a reference product

[English](README.md#user-content-case-person-holding-reference-product) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-person-holding-reference-product) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-person-holding-reference-product) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-person-holding-reference-product) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-person-holding-reference-product) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-person-holding-reference-product) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-person-holding-reference-product) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-person-holding-reference-product) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-person-holding-reference-product)

<a href="https://x.com/AdrianPunk115/status/2098055380857143807"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HR24sTybEAE94tW?format=jpg&amp;name=large" width="640" alt="Person holding a reference product — @AdrianPunk115 — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Combine a person and product with plausible grip, contact shadows, scale, and consistent illumination.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- Image 1: the person reference.
- Image 2: the product reference.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Please generate a natural, realistic product display photo featuring a real person, based on the two uploaded images.

Image 1 serves as the reference for the person, determining their identity, facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, and clothing.
Image 2 serves as the reference for the product, determining its shape, structure, color, material, logo, and packaging details.

Have the person from Image 1 naturally hold the product from Image 2, as if showcasing it to the camera. Position the product in front of the chest or to the side-front of the body, with its main display face turned toward the camera and without obscuring the person's face.

Choose a logical grip based on the product's shape. Fingers should naturally wrap around, cradle, or pinch the product, demonstrating correct depth (foreground/background layering), contact shadows, and physical interaction. The hand should not clip into the product, nor should the product float above the palm.

Preserve the person's recognizable facial features, apparent age, hairstyle, and skin details; do not alter the face or body shape. Adjustments to arm and hand positioning are permitted to facilitate holding the product.

Do not redesign the product. Retain its original silhouette, cap or structural elements, label placement, primary color scheme, and recognizable text. Do not mirror the logo or add extra accessories.

Ensure the person and the product share the same lighting environment to avoid a jarring, pasted-together look. Retain the background from the original photo of the person, but simplify distracting elements as appropriate.

Use a 3:4 vertical format with both the person and the product clearly visible; do not add titles, slogans, or customer reviews.
```

```text
Please place the top from Image 2 onto the person in Image 1 to generate a realistic virtual try-on image.

Image 1 determines the person's identity, body proportions, pose, camera angle, and background.
Image 2 determines the top's style, color, fabric, cut, pattern, and details.

Retain the person's face, hairstyle, skin tone, body shape, and original pose; replace only the top. Do not alter shoulder width, waist size, or body proportions simply to make the garment look better.

Original prints, embroidery, logos, and text must remain in their corresponding positions on the garment. They may follow the natural curves and folds of the fabric but must not be altered, mirrored, added to, removed, or relocated.

Retain the lighting and environment of the original image so the replaced garment blends in naturally. Output only a single try-on image; do not add text or "before-and-after" comparisons. **Please place the top from Image 2 onto the person in Image 1 to generate a realistic virtual try-on image.**
```

[English](README.md#user-content-case-architectural-portal-travel-poster) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-architectural-portal-travel-poster) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-architectural-portal-travel-poster) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-architectural-portal-travel-poster) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-architectural-portal-travel-poster) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-architectural-portal-travel-poster) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-architectural-portal-travel-poster) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-architectural-portal-travel-poster) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-architectural-portal-travel-poster)

<a href="https://x.com/Naiknelofar788/status/2097920025617399875"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HR1PFgUasAAJbTM.jpg" width="640" alt="An architectural portal travel poster — Naiknelofar788 — source result — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Use local architecture as a foreground frame, with a restrained palette and integrated place labels.

**Original prompt · Text to image · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

No reference image is specified by the source.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Create a premium modern travel poster for [CITY, COUNTRY], inspired by bold vintage screen-print and mid-century graphic design, but with an original architectural portal composition.

Place a large distinctive [LOCAL ARCHITECTURAL ELEMENT / GATE / ARCH] in the foreground, acting as a window into the destination. Through the opening, reveal a stylized layered scene featuring [ICONIC LANDMARK], [FAMOUS NATURAL FEATURE], simplified rooftops, local streets, trees, transportation, and a few subtle cultural details.

Add one large bold geometric sun / moon / circle behind the main landmark, using a shape and placement that feels visually striking rather than traditional. Include 2–3 recognizable local symbols naturally within the scene instead of presenting them as separate objects.

Use a limited sophisticated color palette inspired by the destination: [2–5 COLORS]. Flat geometric shapes, strong silhouettes, clean edges, subtle overlapping layers, slight screen-print texture, and elegant negative space.

Add a tall integrated sign or architectural panel featuring:

[CITY]
[LOCAL SCRIPT]

Include small refined editorial typography at the bottom:

[COUNTRY]
[CITY] • [COORDINATES]
[SHORT DESTINATION PHRASE]

Minimal, artistic, cohesive, collectible travel-poster aesthetic, not photorealistic, not a collage, no excessive details, sophisticated composition, strong visual hierarchy, balanced asymmetry, warm paper background, subtle print imperfections, 4:5 vertical format.
```

</details>

## Five-round coffee festival poster editing

[English](README.md#user-content-case-coffee-festival-poster-iterations) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-coffee-festival-poster-iterations) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-coffee-festival-poster-iterations) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-coffee-festival-poster-iterations) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-coffee-festival-poster-iterations) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-coffee-festival-poster-iterations) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-coffee-festival-poster-iterations) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-coffee-festival-poster-iterations) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-coffee-festival-poster-iterations)

<a href="https://x.com/jackzhang123vip/status/2098414576031481953"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HR8M6yHaMAAcFxE?format=jpg&amp;name=large" width="640" alt="Five-round coffee festival poster editing — @jackzhang123vip — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Build a poster and change its palette, title scale, date, and steam in separate rounds.

**Original prompt · Multi-step workflow · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- Use the previous round’s image as the reference for each subsequent edit.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>

#### Step 1

```text
Create a 1024×1536 portrait-oriented “城市咖啡节” poster.
Include only: “城市咖啡节”“一杯咖啡，遇见一座城”
“2026.10.18”“滨江创意中心”.
Use a modern Swiss design style with ivory white, coffee brown, and a touch of cobalt blue; employ a strict grid and ample negative space.
Feature a visual of a pour-over coffee setup in the center. No logos, QR codes, watermarks, or extra text.
```

#### Step 2

```text
Change the color scheme only to black, silver-gray, and fluorescent orange.
Keep the original copy, spelling, typographic hierarchy, element placement, dimensions, coffee subject, and composition unchanged.
```

#### Step 3

```text
Enlarge “城市咖啡节” by approximately 20% and slightly increase the letter spacing.
Keep all other text, colors, positioning, the coffee subject, background, and composition unchanged.
```

#### Step 4

```text
Replace “2026.10.18” with “2026.10.25” only.
The new date must be accurate and appear only once; do not alter any other content.
```

#### Step 5

```text
Remove only the steam above the dripper and naturally restore the area underneath.
Retain all text, coffee equipment, background, shadows, grid lines, colors, and composition.
```

[View this case on Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com/prompt/community-coffee-festival-poster-iterations?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=case--en--coffee-festival-poster-iterations)

</details>

### Make it your own

Follow the steps in order. Reuse prior outputs where required and check external processing before starting.

### Notes

- A distinct illustrated test in the creator’s GPT Image 2.5 article. Shared article engagement is not assigned to individual tests.
- Any scores or observations in the source are the author’s reports, not independent tests by this repository.
- The author reports that the palette change also desaturated the photographed subject. The recipe does not guarantee pixel-identical preservation outside each target.

<details>

```text
Create a clean fashion e-commerce lookbook poster featuring a young female model in a cute, simple autumn outfit.
Use a soft pastel pink, blue and lavender gradient background. Keep the overall design minimal, clean and slightly playful, like a modern Korean/Japanese fashion catalog.

Show the full-body model as the main focus, with realistic skin, natural proportions and clear clothing details. The outfit should be simple and wearable: cardigan or hoodie, fitted top, shorts or pleated skirt, socks and sneakers/Mary Jane shoes.

Add handwritten English annotations with thin arrows pointing to individual clothing pieces, such as “Cardigan”, “Polo Shirt”, “Shorts”, “Sneakers” and “Bag”.

Add a bold English fashion headline at the top: “AUTUMN DAILY OUTFIT”, plus a few small decorative English phrases such as “NEW SEASON 2026”, “SIMPLE · COMFY · BETTER ME” and “OUTFIT IDEAS FOR A BRIGHTER YOU”.

Use a structured rectangular frame around the main content, subtle rounded corners, plenty of negative space, and only a few minimal heart/star doodles.

The final image should feel like a polished fashion e-commerce campaign poster — minimal, youthful, realistic, highly readable typography, clean product presentation, not cluttered, with the outfit as the visual focus.

Vertical 3:4 composition, high-resolution commercial fashion photography.
```

<a id="case-six-frame-expression-gif"></a><a id="user-content-case-six-frame-expression-gif"></a>
## Six-frame expression performance GIF

[English](README.md#user-content-case-six-frame-expression-gif) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-six-frame-expression-gif) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-six-frame-expression-gif) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-six-frame-expression-gif) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-six-frame-expression-gif) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-six-frame-expression-gif) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-six-frame-expression-gif) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-six-frame-expression-gif) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-six-frame-expression-gif)

<a href="https://x.com/AdrianPunk115/status/2098055380857143807"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/tweet_video_thumb/HR26LYObMAAH2TT.jpg" width="640" alt="Six-frame expression performance GIF — @AdrianPunk115 — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Draw six new stages of one expression, then split and assemble the actual frames.

**Original prompt · Multi-step workflow · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- A character reference image and an optional expression description.
- An environment that can generate images and run Python to export PNG, GIF, and ZIP files.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>

#### Step 1

```text
Please use an image generation tool to generate a six-frame sequence of continuous motion images for creating a looping GIF, using the single image I uploaded as a reference.

This step requires actually generating new motion frames. Do not use Python to translate, rotate, scale, or locally stretch the original image to replace drawing.

【角色与动作】

Identify the main person, animal, or cartoon character in the image, preserving their recognizable facial features, hairstyle or fur, patterns, clothing, accessories, and main color scheme.

If the original image is already a sticker or illustration, retain its original style.

If the original image is a photograph, uniformly convert it to a simple and vivid hand-drawn sticker style.

This time, only one facial expression will be created:

【在这里填写，例如：开心大笑；留空则根据上传图片自动选择一个适合的动作】

Focus solely on this one expression; do not draw six unrelated expressions.

【六帧连续表演】

From left to right and top to bottom, present six consecutive stages of the same action:

Frame 1: Initial pose, action not yet fully developed.

Frame 2: Beginning of the pose, facial and related limbs begin to change.

Frame 3: Action unfolds, expression significantly intensified.

Frame 4: Peak of the action, emotion most clearly expressed.

Frame 5: Action subsides, gradually recovering.

Frame 6: Approaching the initial pose, connecting back to Frame 1.

Please design the mouth shape, cheeks, eyebrows, eyes, and limb posture for each frame according to the selected action.

At least one facial feature must show a clear and continuous change, with body movements complementing it. For example, when laughing, the mouth gradually opens and the cheeks lift; when surprised, the mouth widens and the chin drops.

Redrawing the same character's facial features and limb posture at different points in time is allowed. Maintain consistency between the character's identity and appearance; do not lock the eyes, mouth, and posture completely.

When a character wears sunglasses, retain the sunglasses. Express emotions through mouth shape, cheeks, chin, and body language; avoid making the eyes visible through the frame.

Animal movements must conform to their own body structure.

【帧间一致性】

Fix the camera angle, perspective, lighting, painting style, and basic character dimensions.

Use the same composition coordinates and body reference position in each cell. Movement can change local outlines, but do not enlarge or shrink the character frame by frame to fill the cell.

Clothing, accessories, number of limbs, and fur patterns should not be changed arbitrarily.

Existing props and decorations can change reasonably with movement; do not add or remove them randomly.

【序列图排版】

The entire image is 3 columns × 2 rows, with an overall aspect ratio of 3:2. Each cell is a square of equal size.

Use a regular invisible grid; do not draw dividing lines, outlines, text, or frame numbers.

Place only one complete character per cell, including its own props and decorations. Leave approximately 15% white space around the edges; no part should encroach on adjacent squares.

Use true alpha transparency for the background; do not draw a white base or transparent checkerboard pattern. Preserve the white borders of the stickers and the white details inside the main body.

【交付】

Generate this six-frame motion sequence directly; do not create a GIF yet.
```

#### Step 2

```text
Please use Python to read the original file of the previously generated six-frame motion sequence, split it, and combine it into a playable looping GIF.

This round only processes the six already generated motion frames; do not redraw the character or replace these frames with the original static stickers.

【读取与拆分】

Confirm that a readable six-frame original image exists, then extract the six frames in a 3-column × 2-row order, from left to right and from top to bottom.

Check that each frame is complete and does not include the content of adjacent squares.

Preserve the character, limbs, tail, accessories, props, sticker white borders, and all decorations belonging to that frame.

Check for a true alpha transparent background.

If the original image has a solid color opaque background, only separate the outer background, preserving the whites of the eyes, teeth, highlights, white clothing, and white edges of stickers. Do not directly delete all white pixels, and do not treat the checkerboard pattern as a transparent background.

【统一画布与对齐】

The output canvas for all six frames is 512×512.

Prioritize preserving the consistent coordinate relationship of each cell in the original sequence.

When cropping or resizing is required, use the joint boundary of the complete content of the six frames to determine the common cropping range, and apply the same scaling ratio and position offset to all six frames.

Do not crop frame by frame close to the outline and then scale each frame to the maximum size.

Do not recenter frame by frame, as this will disrupt the original motion displacement.

Only correct obvious layout deviations, preserving intentionally designed head and limb movements. Ensure all frames have sufficient safety margins.

【GIF 合成】

Play directly in a loop from 1→2→3→4→5→6→1.

Retain six actual generated content frames; do not add drift, rotation, or scaling effects to the entire sticker.

Default frame durations are: 350, 200, 250, 450, 400, 350 milliseconds.

Total duration: 2 seconds.

Pauses can be fine-tuned based on actual movement, but the final actual duration must be reported.

Do not duplicate a large number of static frames to reach 20 frames per second.

Do not use dissolves, crossfade, or blur frames to fake movement.

Use a unified color palette based on all six frames, reserving a dedicated transparency index, and correctly setting the transparency color, background index, and frame clearing method. Use an infinite loop to avoid ghosting, afterimages, and background flickering.

【实际检查】

After exporting, reopen the GIF and check: Actual number of frames, frame duration, total duration, dimensions, infinite loop settings, transparent areas, and file size.

Check frame by frame for any out-of-frame movement of the character, missing decorations, and any obvious abrupt changes between the last and first frames.

Simultaneously observe the face and limbs to confirm that the playback content comes from six different action states. Do not claim acceptable facial expression changes solely based on pixel change rate.

If the six frames themselves lack action changes, or the character's consistency is clearly incorrect, please specify the problem; do not use overall movement to cover it up.

【交付】

Provide a separate GIF file link.

Also provide a ZIP containing six split PNGs and the GIF.

Briefly report the actual number of frames read, dimensions, total duration, and file size after reopening the file.

Run and export the finished product directly; do not only return code, commands, or static previews. If you encounter situations where you cannot read the material or export it, please explain truthfully; do not provide fictitious links.
```

## Character-driven dance pose sheet

[English](README.md#user-content-case-dance-pose-keyframes) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-dance-pose-keyframes) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-dance-pose-keyframes) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-dance-pose-keyframes) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-dance-pose-keyframes) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-dance-pose-keyframes) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-dance-pose-keyframes) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-dance-pose-keyframes) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-dance-pose-keyframes)

<a href="https://x.com/Mayz1169/status/2098050289819652321"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HR3FLxVbwAAPSjy?format=jpg&amp;name=small" width="640" alt="Character-driven dance pose sheet — @Mayz1169 — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Create sixteen full-body dance keyframes that reflect a referenced character’s personality.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- A full-body character reference image.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Create a single square image featuring a 4×4 grid of 16 unique full-body dance poses based on the uploaded character.

CHARACTER-DRIVEN CHOREOGRAPHY
First, visually interpret the character’s personality and aesthetic through their expression, silhouette, outfit, accessories, proportions, and overall visual style. Use this interpretation to invent a personalized dance vocabulary that feels natural and distinctive to THIS character.

Do not apply a generic dance routine or a predetermined list of poses. Let the character’s attitude determine the rhythm, energy, gestures, posture, footwork, and use of space.

For example, a mischievous character might use cheeky gestures, unexpected weight shifts, and playful hops; a reserved character might favor controlled steps and subtle hand movements; a bold character might use grounded footwork and sharp accents; an ethereal character might move through soft curves and floating transitions. These are illustrative possibilities, not required categories or moves. Combine traits when the design suggests a more nuanced personality.

Develop a recognizable movement motif unique to this character and reinterpret it across several panels without repeating the same pose. Incorporate distinctive design features naturally: flowing sleeves may follow sweeping gestures, heavy boots may inspire grounded steps, and a tail or wings may contribute to balance and expression if present. Do not invent accessories or anatomy.

Make the result feel like this character is expressing themselves through dance, rather than performing an interchangeable pose pack. Keep the movement appropriate to the character’s apparent age, anatomy, clothing, and mobility.

SEQUENCE AND VARIETY
Show 16 distinct key poses from one cohesive, character-specific dance phrase, read left to right and top to bottom. Build a natural progression from an opening gesture through variations and a climax to a signature finish.

Include meaningful variation in silhouette, arm placement, footwork, body orientation, and movement level only where it suits the character. Do not force jumps, squats, exaggerated expressions, or dramatic poses onto a character whose personality calls for restraint. Even subtle choreography should produce clearly distinguishable poses.

Maintain believable balance and natural joints. Use facial expressions, head tilts, hands, and posture to reinforce the same personality throughout. Hair, clothing, and accessories should react naturally to movement.

IDENTITY AND STYLE
Preserve the uploaded character’s identity exactly: face, hairstyle, body proportions, outfit, colors, footwear, and accessories. Maintain the reference image’s rendering style throughout all 16 panels. Do not redesign, recolor, or change costumes. Infer any unseen details conservatively and keep them consistent.

GRID AND PRESENTATION
Exactly four rows and four columns, with 16 equally sized square panels separated by thin black lines. Plain white backgrounds and subtle grounding shadows. Number the panels 1–16 in the upper-left corners.

One full-body character per panel, including all extremities and accessories, with comfortable margins. Consistent character scale, camera distance, lighting, and ground level. Use a fixed eye-level camera; different views should result from the character turning.

If a separate dance-grid reference is provided, use it only for the grid layout and presentation. Do not copy its character, outfit, dance poses, or attitude. The uploaded character must determine the choreography.

OUTPUT
A polished dance reference sheet with strong character identity and 16 individually readable poses. Output only the image, without written analysis.

AVOID
Generic choreography, copied reference poses, repetitive or mirrored duplicates, personality mismatches, forced cuteness or swagger, inconsistent identity, altered outfits, cropped extremities, extra limbs, distorted anatomy, motion trails, missing or extra panels, and text other than panel numbers.
```

</details>

```text
Create a vertical 4:5 cinematic travel-diary poster built around one beautiful family moment in Santorini, Greece.

TOP — REAL PHOTOGRAPHY:
A young couple with their little daughter at a scenic Santorini viewpoint during golden-hour sunset. The daughter is naturally positioned between her parents while both parents gently kiss her cheeks at the same time. She closes her eyes and gives a genuine happy smile. Make the interaction spontaneous, affectionate and completely natural — like a real family vacation photograph, not models posing for an advertisement.

Behind them: iconic white Santorini architecture, blue-domed churches, Mediterranean Sea, distant cliffs, small boats and vibrant bougainvillea. Warm sunset light wraps naturally around their faces and hair. Real skin pores, tiny imperfections, realistic hair strands, accurate hands, natural fabric texture and believable shadows. Shot like a premium full-frame travel photograph, 35mm lens, shallow but realistic depth of field, cinematic dynamic range. Absolutely photorealistic — no AI-looking skin, excessive HDR, plastic faces or artificial expressions.

Keep generous negative space around the subjects for subtle editorial typography. Add only a few refined details such as:
“TRAVEL DIARY”
“Sept 11, 2026”
“SANTORINI — GREECE”
and one small handwritten travel note.

BOTTOM — HAND-PRINTED MEMORY:
Instead of simply duplicating the photograph, reinterpret the same family moment as an original vintage travel-print artwork. Use imperfect screen printing, risograph dots, engraved linework, faded ink, rough edges and authentic paper grain on warm ivory stock.

Build the Santorini landscape around the family as a graphic illustration: simplified blue domes, cliffside houses, sea, sunset and bougainvillea integrated naturally into the composition. Limited ink palette of deep Mediterranean navy, sun-faded terracotta orange, warm ivory and tiny touches of dusty blue.

Use a large expressive hand-painted title:
“MORE GOOD DAYS”

Surround it with only a few carefully placed diary elements: a Santorini postal stamp, tiny handwritten notes, one or two taped miniature travel photographs and “A SMALL DIARY — #001.” Keep everything intentionally imperfect and tactile rather than digitally clean.

The transition between photography and illustration should feel like a torn page from a personal travel journal rather than a basic 50/50 split.

Overall aesthetic: real family vacation photography × independent travel magazine × vintage European tourism poster × handmade screen print.

Warm, intimate, nostalgic and premium. Strong enough to stop someone while scrolling, but never overcrowded. The photograph must feel genuinely captured in real life, while the lower artwork feels physically printed by hand.

No Chinese text. No copied layouts. No generic AI collage aesthetic. No excessive stickers. No fantasy. No fake-looking faces. No malformed hands. No waxy skin. No over-saturation. Keep all three family members consistent between the photographic and illustrated sections.
```


## Complete character production reference sheet

[English](README.md#user-content-case-character-design-reference-sheet) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-character-design-reference-sheet) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-character-design-reference-sheet) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-character-design-reference-sheet) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-character-design-reference-sheet) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-character-design-reference-sheet) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-character-design-reference-sheet) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-character-design-reference-sheet) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-character-design-reference-sheet)

<a href="https://x.com/meAsifAi/status/2097949170594193427"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HR1pU0jbsAAu_UR?format=jpg&amp;name=medium" width="640" alt="Complete character production reference sheet — @meAsifAi — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Keep one character consistent across a turnaround, expressions, poses, costume details, materials, and color palette.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- The character reference image whose identity, outfit, and proportions should be preserved.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Create a premium professional character design reference sheet / production model sheet based strictly on the provided reference image.

REFERENCE & IDENTITY LOCK:
Use the uploaded reference as the single source of truth for the character's identity. Preserve the exact facial identity, facial structure, hairstyle, hairline, eye shape and color, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, body proportions, physique, age appearance, distinctive features, costume design, accessories, footwear, colors, patterns and all recognizable visual details. Do not redesign, beautify, simplify, age, de-age, or reinterpret the character.
CHARACTER DESIGN ANALYSIS:
Before constructing the sheet, internally analyze and lock the character's:

facial construction
head-to-body ratio

body proportions

shoulder width and torso structure

limb length and joint placement

silhouette

hairstyle and hair volume

costume construction

accessory placement

color relationships

material characteristics

distinctive identity anchors

All subsequent views must represent the exact same character design.

PAGE FORMAT:
Create one sophisticated studio-grade character reference board, landscape 16:9, clean neutral/off-white studio background, refined editorial production-board aesthetic, highly organized hierarchy, generous spacing, subtle technical guide lines, restrained professional typography-style labels where appropriate, no decorative clutter.

01 — HERO CHARACTER PORTRAIT

Place one larger polished head-and-shoulders or three-quarter portrait as the visual identity anchor.
Show the character's canonical facial identity clearly with neutral professional expression and accurate hairstyle, skin, costume and accessories.

02 — FULL-BODY TURNAROUND

Create a clearly organized full-body turnaround showing the same character at identical scale and proportions:

FRONT VIEW

3/4 FRONT VIEW

SIDE PROFILE

3/4 BACK VIEW

BACK VIEW

Use a neutral standing pose with consistent posture and anatomical alignment.

Keep head height, eye line, shoulder line, waist, hips, knees and feet consistently aligned across every view.

The costume, hairstyle, accessories, seams, patterns, footwear and silhouette must remain identical from every angle.

03 — EXPRESSION STUDY

Include a clean expression grid containing approximately 6 expressions:

Neutral

Happy / subtle smile

Serious

Angry / determined

Surprised

Sad / emotional

Maintain the exact same facial identity, head proportions, hairstyle and facial construction in every expression.

Expressions should demonstrate believable facial acting rather than exaggerated deformation.

04 — SIGNATURE POSE STUDIES

Include 4–6 full-body pose studies that communicate the character's personality and physical behavior.

Use varied but believable poses such as:

relaxed standing

confident stance

walking

sitting

interacting with an object

dynamic signature pose

Maintain exact character proportions, costume construction and recognizable silhouette in every pose.

05 — COSTUME & DETAIL CALLOUTS

Add several clean close-up detail panels showing the most important design elements:

hairstyle / hair detail

face detail

collar / neckline

sleeves / garment construction

footwear

jewelry or accessories

distinctive emblem / pattern / texture

important prop if present

Show construction and material clearly without turning the sheet into a decorative fashion collage.

06 — MATERIAL STUDIES

Visually communicate the primary materials present in the design:

fabric, leather, metal, denim, silk, knit, plastic, glass, jewelry, hair, skin or other relevant materials.

Show realistic surface behavior, texture, reflectivity and construction appropriate to each material.

07 — COLOR PALETTE

Include a compact professional color palette strip containing the dominant character colors.

Organize colors according to their visual role:

skin

hair

primary costume

secondary costume

accent color

accessories / materials

Keep the palette faithful to the reference.

08 — PROPORTION & SILHOUETTE GUIDE

Include a subtle technical proportion guide beside the turnaround.

Show:

overall height

head-to-body ratio

major horizontal alignment guides

key body proportions

clean silhouette thumbnail

Keep this section understated and production-oriented.

09 — DESIGN CONTINUITY

Treat the entire page as a single canonical character source of truth.

Every panel must depict the SAME person/character with:

identical facial identity

identical body proportions

identical hairstyle

identical costume

identical accessory placement

identical color palette

identical design language

consistent left/right details

No accidental costume changes, missing accessories, duplicated accessories, altered facial features, changing body proportions, inconsistent hairstyles or unexplained design variations.

VISUAL DIRECTION:
High-end professional character design presentation, studio production reference quality, sophisticated concept-art discipline, clean polished rendering, precise construction, controlled neutral lighting, realistic material definition, excellent anatomical consistency, crisp readable details, refined editorial layout, premium art-direction quality.

The sheet should feel like an actual professional animation / game / visual-development production document, not a collection of random AI images.

COMPOSITION:
Clear information hierarchy, balanced negative space, aligned panels, consistent character scale, clean grid system, logical visual flow, no overlapping figures, no cropped bodies, no confusing perspective, no unnecessary scenery.

CAMERA / VIEW CONTROL:
Turnaround views should use consistent orthographic-like framing and neutral perspective. Expression studies should use a consistent head framing. Pose studies may use natural perspective while preserving character proportions.
LIGHTING:
Neutral studio illumination designed for design inspection rather than cinematic drama. Soft, even, physically believable light with controlled shadows and accurate material readability.

PHOTOGRAPHIC / RENDER FINISH:
Ultra-clean high-end visual development presentation, realistic surface detail, natural skin and hair rendering, physically believable materials, sharp but refined detail, professional production-board finish.

OUTPUT QUALITY:
16K: 15360 × 8640 ≈ 132.7 million pixels, high-resolution professional quality.
NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS:
No character redesign, no identity drift, no inconsistent proportions, no changing face, no changing hairstyle, no costume variations, no missing accessories, no duplicated accessories, no extra limbs, no malformed hands, no distorted anatomy, no random props, no dramatic scenery, no cinematic background, no excessive effects, no clutter, no watermark, no logo, no cropped views.
```

[View this case on Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com/prompt/community-character-design-reference-sheet?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=case--en--character-design-reference-sheet)

</details>

### Make it your own

Supply your own references, state the role of each, and separate what changes from what must stay.

### Notes

- The full source prompt is preserved, including its requested 16K dimensions. Those dimensions are an instruction, not a verified output resolution or a promise of model support.
- The creator provides a single production-board result. The repository has not independently verified identity consistency across all panels.

[English](README.md#user-content-case-separate-frame-animation) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-separate-frame-animation) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-separate-frame-animation) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-separate-frame-animation) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-separate-frame-animation) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-separate-frame-animation) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-separate-frame-animation) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-separate-frame-animation) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-separate-frame-animation)

#### Step 1

```text
Create nine separate variations of the supplied character image for a gentle animation. Change the pose only slightly between frames. Keep the character’s size, position, identity, and background consistent.
```

#### Step 2

```text
Inspect and align the frames, then assemble them into a looping GIF. If the motion needs more in-between frames, create another set using the same references.
```

<a id="case-pixel-pet-loop"></a><a id="user-content-case-pixel-pet-loop"></a>
## Pixel-art pet animation sheet

[English](README.md#user-content-case-pixel-pet-loop) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-pixel-pet-loop) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-pixel-pet-loop) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-pixel-pet-loop) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-pixel-pet-loop) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-pixel-pet-loop) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-pixel-pet-loop) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-pixel-pet-loop) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-pixel-pet-loop)

<a href="https://x.com/Mayz1169/status/2097575677130379754"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/tweet_video_thumb/HRwUqb0aEAA_VkS.jpg" width="640" alt="Pixel-art pet animation sheet — @Mayz1169 — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Translate a pet’s identifying features into a consistent 4×4 pixel-art loop.

**Original prompt · Multi-step workflow · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- A pet reference photograph.
- A tool that can split a sprite sheet and export animation files.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Turn the pet in my uploaded reference image into an adorable pixel-art sprite with a subtle, seamless looping animation.

PET REFERENCE
Use the uploaded image as the visual reference. Preserve the pet’s species, recognizable colors, markings, body shape, eye color, and distinctive features, including any visible accessories.

Adapt the pet into cute chibi proportions while keeping its natural anatomy recognizable. Preserve species-appropriate legs, paws, wings, fins, tails, ears, shells, or other features. Do not add limbs or features the animal does not have. Do not turn the pet into a human-shaped character or default to a cat-like design.

If the reference is cropped, infer the missing body details naturally from the visible animal. If multiple pets appear, use the most prominent pet unless I specify otherwise.

STYLE
Create crisp, charming pixel art with clearly defined square pixels, clean outlines, gentle shading, and a cohesive limited palette.
Use expressive features appropriate to the animal.
No blurry edges, smooth vector styling, photorealistic rendering, or anti-aliased outlines.

POSE AND ANIMATION
Create 16 consecutive frames of one gentle, species-appropriate idle animation.

Choose a comfortable resting, standing, perched, or hovering pose that suits this pet’s anatomy. Prefer a front-facing or slight three-quarter view that shows its recognizable features.

Include:
- A subtle breathing or resting motion appropriate to the species.
- One small secondary motion, such as an ear twitch, tail sway, feather settling, antenna movement, or gentle fin movement.
- One brief natural blink only if the species has movable eyelids.

Choose only movements that make sense for this animal. Animals without movable eyelids must not blink. Do not force paw gestures, sitting poses, or mammal-like expressions onto other species.

Keep the animation restrained and readable:
- Keep the pet in the same position.
- Anchor feet or other contact points for grounded animals.
- For swimming or hovering animals, keep the body centered with minimal drift.
- Keep the anatomy, markings, accessories, proportions, camera angle, and scale consistent.
- No walking, turning, large gestures, camera movement, or scene changes.
- Make the last frame transition smoothly back to the first.

SPRITE SHEET
Arrange the 16 frames in exactly 4 columns × 4 rows, ordered left to right, top to bottom.

Canvas: 1024 × 1024 pixels.
Each cell: 256 × 256 pixels.

Use identical alignment, a fixed body anchor, and a consistent baseline across all cells.
Choose a scale that accommodates the pet’s widest animation pose.
Keep the entire pet inside each cell, with at least 16 pixels of transparent padding on every side, including around moving tails, wings, fins, ears, and accessories.

These are consecutive frames of the SAME pet, not separate character variations.
No overlapping cells, grid lines, labels, text, or watermarks.

TRANSPARENCY
Use a genuinely transparent RGBA background with alpha zero outside the pet.
Do not draw a checkerboard or add a solid background, scenery, floor, water, or cast shadow.
Preserve white and pale details inside the pet.

If background removal is necessary, use a careful foreground mask. Do not globally erase a color that also appears in the pet’s body, markings, or accessories.

DELIVERABLES
Complete the actual files, not just instructions:

1. A transparent 4 × 4 PNG sprite sheet at 1024 × 1024 pixels.
2. A transparent animated GIF of the single pet, using all 16 frames at 256 × 256 pixels, looping forever with a 2.4-second cycle: 150 milliseconds per frame.
3. A ZIP containing all 16 individual transparent PNG frames, named frame_01.png through frame_16.png in playback order.

Use available image-generation and file-processing tools to generate the artwork, split the sheet, and assemble the GIF.

Split the sheet into equal cells. Keep every exported frame on the same 256 × 256 canvas. Do not independently crop or scale frames, as this can cause jitter.
Use nearest-neighbor sampling if resizing is needed to preserve crisp pixels.
Configure GIF transparency and frame disposal so previous frames leave no trails.

QUALITY CHECK
Before exporting, inspect all 16 frames and preview the assembled animation.

Check for:
- Consistent species, anatomy, markings, and limb count.
- Stable body position, scale, and contact points.
- Clipped ears, tails, wings, fins, or accessories.
- Stray pixels or fragments from neighboring cells.
- Accidental removal of pale or white body details.
- Background artifacts, unwanted position jumps, or GIF trails.
- A smooth transition from the last frame back to the first.

Fix any issues before delivering. Ensure the PNG files and GIF have genuinely transparent backgrounds.

Provide the finished files with a GIF preview and download links.

If your environment cannot create or attach an animated GIF or ZIP, clearly state which deliverables could not be completed. Do not present a static image as a completed animation.
```

[View this case on Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com/prompt/community-pixel-pet-loop?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=case--en--pixel-pet-loop)

</details>

### Make it your own

Follow the steps in order. Reuse prior outputs where required and check external processing before starting.

### Notes

- The author reuses their full cat-example prompt for a dog result; both are represented as one reusable pet recipe.
- The full prompt is in the linked original reply. The dog example supplies the preview and engagement snapshot.

## Vintage baker portrait series

[English](README.md#user-content-case-vintage-baker-portraits) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-vintage-baker-portraits) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-vintage-baker-portraits) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-vintage-baker-portraits) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-vintage-baker-portraits) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-vintage-baker-portraits) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-vintage-baker-portraits) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-vintage-baker-portraits) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-vintage-baker-portraits)

<details>
<summary>Suggestive adult styling — Explore with context</summary>

<a href="https://x.com/Lonely__MH/status/2097659111798390968"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HRxhydObkAA62IH?format=jpg&amp;name=medium" width="640" alt="Vintage baker portrait series — @Lonely__MH — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Compose a coherent adult portrait series in a sunlit retro kitchen.

**Original prompt · Text to image · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

No reference image is specified by the source.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Create a 9:16 photorealistic vintage baker portrait series with a soft, intimate POV feeling.

Use the same beautiful adult East Asian woman across the set, with direct eye contact, realistic skin texture, soft natural hair, and a sensual but natural presence. She wears a simple backless summer kitchen dress in ivory or soft cream, with a light apron and a delicate headscarf. The setting is a refined retro Shaker-style kitchen with mushroom-gray cabinets, dark walnut counters, warm gray stone surfaces, subtle brass hardware, and clean summer daylight.

This batch should focus more on body language, eye contact, and pose geometry than on big action scenes. The woman must remain the clear visual focus in every frame.

Include elegant kitchen portrait moments such as:

* sitting on a countertop with one long leg extended and one foot placed on a stool

* offering a slice of strawberry cake toward the viewer

* sitting backwards on a high stool with her arms resting on the chair back

* reaching upward in the kitchen while keeping a playful connection with the camera

Keep the mood vintage, feminine, playful, and slightly flirty. Every image should feel like a captured moment inside the same retro kitchen scene, with the viewer standing close to her.

Vary the face angle across the series. Do not repeat the same three-quarter face in every image. Use a mix of front-facing eye contact, side glances, profile-based eye contact, upward gaze, and slightly lowered chin with lifted eyes, so the set feels alive and not like the same face pasted onto different poses.

Use posture, shoulders, waistline, long legs, and eye contact as the main source of visual interest. Poses should feel relaxed but intentional, with a light editorial quality.

Props must stay secondary. If props appear, keep them small and supportive, such as a strawberry cake slice, a wooden spoon, a whisk, a small tray, a folded linen cloth, or a small glass jar. Avoid oversized opaque objects, large bowls, or bulky cookware that block the torso or steal attention from the model.

Lighting should be soft, clean, and summery. Keep the overall color balance neutral to slightly warm. The retro feeling must come from the kitchen style, wardrobe, textures, and atmosphere — not from a heavy yellow or orange filter. Skin should stay natural, ivory clothing should stay ivory, and gray cabinets should remain gray.

The final result should feel intimate, stylish, feminine, vintage, and editorial, with realistic anatomy, realistic skin, believable expressions, and a lived-in but elegant kitchen environment.

Avoid repetitive face angles, stiff posing, oversized props, yellow color cast, orange skin, distorted hands, exaggerated wide-angle body distortion, cluttered backgrounds, complex strap designs, and obvious AI artifacts.
```

[View this case on Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com/prompt/community-vintage-baker-portraits?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=case--en--vintage-baker-portraits)

</details>

## Soft CCD fitting-room portrait

[English](README.md#user-content-case-nineties-japanese-ccd-photo) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md#user-content-case-nineties-japanese-ccd-photo) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md#user-content-case-nineties-japanese-ccd-photo) · [日本語](README.ja.md#user-content-case-nineties-japanese-ccd-photo) · [한국어](README.ko.md#user-content-case-nineties-japanese-ccd-photo) · [Français](README.fr.md#user-content-case-nineties-japanese-ccd-photo) · [Deutsch](README.de.md#user-content-case-nineties-japanese-ccd-photo) · [Español](README.es.md#user-content-case-nineties-japanese-ccd-photo) · [Português (Brasil)](README.pt-BR.md#user-content-case-nineties-japanese-ccd-photo)

<details>
<summary>Suggestive adult styling — Explore with context</summary>

<a href="https://x.com/BubbleBrain/status/2098315158997307550"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HR62IojbwAAfQ9w?format=jpg&amp;name=medium" width="640" alt="Soft CCD fitting-room portrait — @BubbleBrain — Source result" loading="lazy"></a>

Use highlight bloom, lifted blacks, and natural skin detail for a 1990s magazine portrait.

**Original prompt · Text to image · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

No reference image is specified by the source.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
9:16 vertical, ultra-realistic portrait photography, 90s Japanese magazine fitting-room photoshoot style, soft-light CCD texture, obvious highlight bloom and slight haze.
A clearly adult Korean female idol, about 23–27 years old, fair natural skin, slender well-proportioned figure, shoulder-length black straight hair slightly messy and fluffy, long bangs falling naturally and partially covering one eye. Delicate features, haughty and languid expression, slightly looking down at the camera. Soft pink natural makeup, gentle pink lips. Keep real skin texture, fine pores, and natural facial asymmetry.
She wears a black thin cropped short-sleeve T-shirt in soft fitted cotton, hem stopping at the upper abdomen and exposing the waist, midriff, and natural navel. Bottom: black minimalist low-rise bikini-style bottoms, waistline sitting naturally near the hip bones, simple design.
She stands in a small 90s Japanese magazine-style fitting room with light beige-gray walls, a narrow full-length mirror, simple hooks, and soft overhead lighting. Natural standing pose: one leg supporting, the other slightly bent forward, hip shifted naturally to one side. Thinking pose 🤔: one hand raised, index finger lightly resting on the chin, thumb near the jawline, gesture natural and restrained; the other hand hanging naturally at her side. Head slightly tilted, eyes looking down at the camera with a careless, thoughtful look.
Low-angle upward shot, camera close to the subject, slight wide-angle without exaggerated distortion, emphasizing vertical leg extension and slender proportions. Composition includes the head, upper body, full waist and midriff, hips, and most of the legs. Subject occupies the main part of the frame.
Soft hazy lighting. Soft scattered light from the front and above. Slight overexposure on the cheeks, nose bridge, collarbones, shoulders, waist, midriff, and legs, blooming softly outward into clear highlight overflow, halation, bloom, and soft fog. Highlights are creamy white glow; shadows are soft and pale with no hard edges.
Overall low contrast, low saturation, creamy gray and pale warm skin tones, slightly lifted blacks, fine CCD noise and film grain, slightly soft edges, soft-focus filter, and atmospheric haze. Like a casually captured page from a 90s Asian photo magazine.
Photorealistic, real-camera photography, real skin, hair strands, and fabric texture. Soft CCD, highlight bloom, hazy and dreamy but not over-retouched.
Avoid: plastic skin, excessive beautification, over-sharpening, HDR, hard light, strong shadows, anime look, CGI, fisheye, exaggerated wide-angle, limb deformities, extra or wrong fingers, cluttered background, cheap influencer filters.
```

[View this case on Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com/prompt/community-nineties-japanese-ccd-photo?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=case--en--nineties-japanese-ccd-photo)

</details>

Allocate a fixed item count across a portrait, two text pins and five symbolic objects.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- Upload a clear portrait reference, and provide the character name, personality word and five interests.

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Create a hyper-realistic enamel pin collection in a vertical 4:5 composition on a dark textured background. Design exactly 8 separate premium pins with polished gold-metal outlines, glossy hard-enamel surfaces, subtle raised edges, realistic reflections, and soft shadows. The main medium-sized center pin is a portrait of [CHARACTER], preserving the reference image’s recognizable face, hairstyle, skin tone, expression, clothing, and key features while translating them into a detailed premium enamel illustration. Add 1 small name pin reading “[NAME]” and 1 small personality-word pin reading “[WORD]”. The remaining 5 pins should represent [CHARACTER]’s interests and lifestyle, such as creative work, AI/technology, visual creation, photography, travel, friendship, hobbies, or everyday objects, using clever symbolic illustrations rather than excessive text. Arrange everything organically around the portrait with varied pin shapes and sizes, generous spacing, and no rigid grid. Use bold, flat, bright colors with sophisticated contrast, crisp details, realistic metallic depth, and high-end commercial product lighting. Make it feel like a limited-edition designer pin set photographed in a studio—modern, vibrant, personal, collectible, and instantly eye-catching. No city names or specific landmarks, no duplicated pins, no clutter, no random text, no misspellings, no cheap cartoon or plastic appearance.
```
